unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes: Cumulative PCIe hardware byte counters remain unknown: they require a successful collector-specific probe; only NVML pcie.tx/pcie.rx rates are observable, as device-wide readings in ~20 ms driver sampling windows not aligned to operator ranges; no traffic is inferred from logical payload or memcpy sizes (model loading is outside the timed boundary and decode traffic is not a counter reading)
unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: No NVLink traffic dimension exists in this single-device task: the communication capability is not_applicable with observed reason 'single-device task', no peer or link endpoints are in evidence, per-link counters require reported link IDs and a successful read-only probe, and payload sizes are never converted to wire traffic
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: Counter-based hardware utilization is unknown: it requires a successful collector-specific probe; NVML device.gpu_utilization is a device-wide sampling ratio with a device-dependent native window not aligned to operator ranges, not a hardware-counter measurement of per-kernel occupancy
unavailable_fields.nccl_kernel_duration: not_applicable: single-device task (distributed_backend null, one leased device); the discovery trace contains no NCCL/collective kernels, so collective duration, identity, transport and bucket dimensions have nothing to measure and collective_calibration layouts would have no observed source collectives
unavailable_fields.gpu_input_ready: execution_timeline evidences clock alignment bounds for CPU submissions only; GPU producer readiness for the decode chain's consumers is not proven by CPU-side association and remains unknown
unavailable_fields.consumer_completion: no unique data-consumer/event dependency is proven for the single-device stream; downstream kernel start is an enqueue/scheduling-inclusive interval, not an observed completion dependency

plan.rationale: torch already ran and is retained as the attribution baseline for the frozen objective (maximize generated_tokens_per_second, paired_repeats 2, with ttft_ms min and decode_tokens_per_second max on the interactive workload: batch 1, 256 prompt tokens, 32 new tokens): coverage shows 66441/66441 cuda_kernels associated with 0 unassociated, 0 root_only, 0 backward-associated kernels, 0 autograd ranges and 0 ambiguous forward sequences, so per-kernel attribution is complete and no graph-tracing or attribution question remains open. The workload is a pure single-device bf16 sdpa inference loop (qwen_inference.py: 256-token prefill then 31 single-token forward passes with logits_to_keep=1, per-step argmax, and explicit torch.cuda.synchronize at the first-token-ready boundary and at the end), so the tokens/s lever is how step time splits between GPU kernel activity, inter-kernel gaps from host dispatch, synchronization and copies. execution_timeline is selected for its separately captured plain Torch trace per-device intervals (kernel_span_us, kernel_active_union_us, gaps_between_kernels_us, compute_intervals_us), cuda_synchronization and copies_and_memsets within the opop.timeline_workload window: these quantify whether decode is GPU-bound or gap-bound without touching the clean objective run. Its limits are respected: clock alignment bounds apply to CPU submissions only; gpu_input_ready and consumer_completion stay unknown; gaps are observed intervals, not a causal critical path; gradient_readiness is inactive at world_size 1; and it never replaces a communication hook (none exists here) nor determines subsequent search actions. python_runtime is selected for a warmed cProfile call trace (by_self_time, by_cumulative_time, profiled_wall_ms) to rank host dispatch and binding costs in the per-token transformers loop; it perturbs execution, so its inclusive/self times include host waits, are not clean performance scores, not GPU compute durations, and never substitute for the objective's own timing. device_telemetry is selected for workload-window NVML sampling of pcie.tx, pcie.rx, device.gpu_utilization, device.memory_utilization and device.memory_used: these are device-wide readings with native sampling windows (not per-collective or per-op bytes, and PCIe traffic is never derived from payload or memcpy sizes) and give independent device-level occupancy plus memory headroom for later candidate scoping. nsys is not selected: it is optional and justified only for open overlap, graph-tracing or attribution questions, and the evidence closes all three (full association, zero ambiguous sequences, single rank so the no-cross-rank-subtraction clock policy and any wait-vs-wire NCCL separation are moot); torch plus execution_timeline already cover timeline, gaps and sync for this single stream. collective_calibration is not selected: communication is not_applicable with observed reason 'single-device task', the trace contains no collectives, and its synthetic full-world SUM allreduce reference experiment would calibrate nothing this workload executes. candidate_diagnostics is not selected: it traces candidate-installer behavior during the later search and no candidate evidence exists yet. pcie_bytes, nvlink_bytes, hardware_utilization, nccl_kernel_duration, gpu_input_ready and consumer_completion are listed unavailable with their observed reasons; the framework verifies availability and retains missing fields as unknown.
